Visit the Kumon Centre to help your child build strong learning habits that last a lifetime.

Learn by Ability Not by Age at Kumon

Whether a student is looking to catch up, stay on track, or advance beyond grade level, Kumon’s individualized learning plan meets them where they are and challenges them to grow further. By focusing on ability over age, Kumon nurtures independent thinkers who can take on new challenges with confidence and curiosity—skills that benefit them well beyond the classroom.
